#### Image Concept 7 — Social (1080x1350)

research.facts:
NCAA 5-for-5 Eligibility Rule
**Sources:** The IX Sports, Extra Inning Softball, Sports Illustrated (Softball on SI), Yahoo Sports (first search)
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- NCAA Division I Cabinet passed new age-based eligibility rule June 24, 2026 [IX Sports, SI]
- New model: five years to compete in five full seasons (replaces four seasons in five years) [IX Sports]
- Eleven athletes filed federal class action lawsuit against the new rules [Yahoo Sports first search]
- A handful of 2027 softball recruits have started to decommit following the rule [SI Oct 26 piece]
- Memphis reportedly pulled offers from multiple 2027 high school commits after rule passed [SI]
**MEDIUM confidence:**
- Ohio governor issued order telling schools to ignore the rule; NCAA filed lawsuit against Ohio governor [Yahoo first search — specific lawsuit details unverified from primary source]
